En en beach club nos ofrecieron un paquete para rentar una Balinesa frente al mar y nos dieron una botella de Moët y mariscos, los mariscos estaban malísimos de sabor. Y la atención del beach club Kanna fue PÉSIMA, el mesero fue muy desatento, si no le hablábamos no venía a ver si se nos ofrecía algo, estábamos batallando para cerrar las cortinas de la balinesa y nos vio y se pasó de largo en vez de ayudar.  Otro detalle enorme No me quisieron emitir mi factura fiscal porque la reserva estaba a mi nombre y yo la necesitaba a nombre de mi esposo porque pagamos con su tarjeta fiscal. Una tontería, jamás me habían echo algo así en otro lugar… a ver ahora como justifico esos 30 mil pesos. Porque ellos dicen que NO se puede. Muy mal trato para haber pagado $4,100!!!! Unfortunately, aside from the room updates, nothing else seems to have changed.

The buffet had very limited food options, and there were extremely long lines -we even had to wait for something as simple as boiled eggs.

During lunch, staff were painting areas nearby, and the smell of paint spread throughout the entire buffet, which was quite unpleasant.

Room service was inconsistent -after calling, it took about three hours for them to show up. By that time it was already late at night, and we had put up the “Do Not Disturb” sign, which was ignored.

Housekeeping was below expectations. We had to document issues with photos, including hair in cups, dirty tissues with debris, and cigarette packaging, and send them to the concierge.

Waiting times are a serious issue at this hotel -waiting an hour for a burger by the pool seems to be considered normal. In general, waiting is part of the experience here.

The gym is outdated -while it has basic equipment, everything is quite worn out and could definitely use an upgrade

reviews.title: Underwhelming, boring and scammy
reviews.text:
Nothing specific to the property. Cancun’s beaches by themselves are beautiful. / The room we stayed in was average with poor air conditioning. 
This property needs to look up the meaning of the word “hospitality”. 
The concierge and guest services teams are slow, clueless, unhelpful and incompetent. 
They call themselves “all inclusive” but constantly try to get you to spend your hard earned $$$ at every conceivable opportunity. For example there are restaurants in the hotel that you need to pay extra for??? Oh and you need to make reservations for the majority of the restaurants. Pool beds and cabanas are up for rental even though there aren’t enough “free” ones to accommodate all guests. Seriously? If you’re going to up-charge your guests at every opportunity at least have the decency to make it abundantly clear that your property isn’t exactly all inclusive in the true sense of the word. 
The property is sleepy at night and the entertainment is forgettable. 
Spend a little more money to stay at a brand name resort like Hyatt because you actually get an all inclusive experience. It’s a real shame because the beach itself is so beautiful.

reviews.text:
Room had a great view, buffet option was good and some decent staff people. / Wow where do I begin?
Why is this hotel so popular (I am still in disbelief)?
We stayed 8 days / 7 nights with family concierge service.
We were told we cannot make any restaurant reservation until you arrive. As soon as we got there - they said family concierge will help restaurant reservation. And yet we were unable to get table at most decent restaurants as they are all booked. Steak one - only adults. The Kanna beach club ( the great photos of cabanas you see onlime)  - is only if you pay $250 extra / day / cabana. Snd also extra for food. Even with all inclusive resort.  Also by the pool - all this pretty cabanas pictures u see facing the ocean .. Only if u pay $250 extra/ day . Most of these cabanas were empty as no one wanted to pay. We had no lounge chairs most days .

The beach or swimming pool lounge chairs - you will be lucky if you get one - only to find out  you have go wake up 5.30am- 6am  and go down n save a spot . Or leave towel. So one morning I was up by 6 n saved a spot by poll. But was told not to leave your spot??? ( So I should just sit there without going back to room for shower or get breakfast??

Anyways I left my kids swim jackets on the chairs n went to my room. Came back with my family after breakfast-    Stuff was all gone.  Took us hours to locate our stuff. Most days we put towels on ground / beach without any chairs.   Most days we ordered  in our room with  limited menu  ( horrible ) inspite of restaurants as they  have no tables available at Capella or Cielo or lemon fish or steak
Only time given go us for 5.30pm reservation which we did couple of times but couldn’t eat this early dinner anymore.  Also you are not allowed to take food or order     In your room from any of the restaurants.

The buffet for breakfast was a joke too . Omelette station - if you really want to stand 45 min :) Only time to get decent breakfast if u wake up again 6.

reviews.title: At the wnd end of the day we enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Cancun all inclusive.
reviews.text: Honest review here.  The facility is beautiful with all the plants in the hotel.  The food was average. There was only one restaurant open during the lunch hours of 11:30-1:00-you could order food by the pool. The beach is beautiful and well kept with security walking around the premises which made us feel safe at all times and kept locals from selling to you on the beach.  Our room was clean, but decor was not what you see on the pictures they advertise and NEED to be updated.  Our last day there we noticed a lot of water leaking from the ceiling in our bathroom.  It must have been due to the storms that occurred during the night. Big plus was the Airconditioning in our room was great, because everywhere else in the hotel seemed very warm.  Some restaurants were hot, others were not. The staff is excellent and very friendly. / The inner hotel is very hot and it was hard to sit and enjoy the nightly entertainment.  Our room was very dated and needs to be updated as were all the rooms in our party of 9

reviews.title: Good but not exceptional
reviews.text:
The room was clean, the staff was pleasant and there were always enough staff around to ask any questions. Food options abundant although not always open or available. Breakfast is pretty much limited to buffet but it’s very varied and flavors are good, sometimes line was huge. / All inclusive sit down restaurants had ok food but somewhat of a limited menu, I guess so that you went to paid restaurants. Didn’t get to try many because they were closed at the times I went. I eat early lunch and dinner, not a late dinner, so perhaps my fault. 
It’s sad to say but I found myself enjoying the buffet more than sit down restaurant as I found it offered more options. 
The pasta restaurant was by reservation, but they never answered the phone to make one. 
Room service is included and prompt and pleasant but limited menu as well
Now when it comes to the pool, it can use some facelift and maintenance. Seating is limited and guests take the chairs and out their belongings on them and leave for hours, so no one can use them, even if the pool is empty, it forces you almost to rent the poolside beds at over $200. 
To get pool towels, it’s only at once place and it’s quite a walk. 
It’s a resort, you’d expect pools to be heated, and also to close a bit late, none of which happen here. 
The kids club closes at 9:45 so nothing for them to do at night either 
No organized activities for kids during the day, so ok for bigger kids perhaps teens but not a kid Resort overall 
Is it gorgeous yes, do I have anything negative to say, no
But the place Can use a facelift, maintenance is lacking in small things and overall there are so many resorts that coming back would not be my goal in Cancun. 
I went for my son’s birthday mentioned it at check in and in the reservation and not even a balloon for him, it was Cielo Lindo restaurant that sang Happy Birthday to him during dinner in our last night there. 
Our room had a couch that was dripping wet and they brought us towels to sit on upon arrival, we weren’t even offered a room change. That room had a shower curtain that was too short so the bathroom got soaked every time. Like I said it’s all in the details. 
We did tip staff every meal, and the housekeeping staff daily and upon departure as they were all great
